name: jg-product-design-plugin-codex
description: Product-design skills for B-side PRD discussion, security-triggered PRD and prototype design, design-review memos, browser-based UI acceptance, HTML prototype generation, prototype-to-PRD backfill, R&D Word requirement specifications, editable prototype annotations, prototype self-check, and ZenTao SR preparation.

interface.shortDescription: PRD, security-by-design, review, prototype, and acceptance workflows.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin migrated from the original Claude product-design skills. It supports rough-demand to PRD discussion, iteration-triggered security requirements, security-rule mapping into prototypes, upload-ready design-review memos, browser-based UI acceptance against design inputs and shared standards, prototype-to-PRD detail backfill, self-contained R&D Word requirement specifications, editable prototype annotations, product/UI/security self-check reports, and PRD scope splitting for ZenTao SR preparation.
defaultPrompt: 把这个粗需求梳理成 PRD 思路。
根据这份设计评审逐字稿整理可上传的设计评审备忘录。
对照 UI 设计和规范验收这个已实现页面的视觉与交互。
根据这份 PRD 做 HTML 原型。
根据评审通过的原型反写 PRD 细则和 PRD，再生成研发对接版 Word 需求说明书。
检查这个原型并给整改要求。
